data.title: Passport application appointment on 12 May 2026
data.summary: The Musterstadt citizens' office (Bürgeramt) confirmed your appointment to apply for a passport on 12 May 2026 at 9:30. Bring your current ID, a biometric photo and the €70.00 fee.
data.explanation: This confirms your appointment to apply for a passport (Reisepass) at the Bürgeramt Mitte, counter 4. Bring your current ID, a recent biometric passport photo and the €70.00 fee; card payment is possible. If you can't attend, cancel the appointment online so the slot can be given to someone else.
